paraphrase: The liberations taught by others — the isolation of puruṣa (Sāṃkhya), the extinction of the soul's special qualities (Vaiśeṣika), the cessation of the stream of cognitions (Buddhists), merging into the one Brahman (Vedānta), the Pāñcarātra and Pāśupata views of the soul's attaining or receiving the Lord's qualities, and others — are refuted; none is true release.
notes: Rival views are as reported by Sadyojyoti (reporting source: Paramokṣanirāsakārikā). Whole-work reference; list partial and moderate confidence.
